messages.content: Can you find me case law details of Case No 28473 and 64725, their history and details of litigants?

function.name: law_case_get_details
function.description: Fetches detailed information on a specific case including its history and the litigants involved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_number.description: The unique number identifying the case.

include_history.description: Flag indicating if case history should be included. Default is false.

include_litigants.description: Flag indicating if litigant details should be included. Default is false.
